extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT must be paid before applying for the grant
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the executors of an illiquid Bath estate valued at around £382,500 enquires about borrowing £27,000 to pay the inheritance tax due before the grant can be applied for.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the inheritance tax liability on this estate. We have noted the approximate estate value of £382,500 and the £27,000 sought, together with your firm's involvement as instructed solicitors. To take this further we would need details of the estate's assets and liabilities, confirmation of the executors and their consent, the IHT400 figures or HMRC calculation, any relevant payment deadline, and confirmation of whether any other borrowing or charges affect the estate. Once we have those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
